review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–72) and searched the repo for the false_of_*_le_localRank helpers. The only repeated reasoning is in excluded433_of_hasWitness_four and excluded433_of_hasWitness_three. Both have the same short opening: intro, the equivalence cast, and Finite.of_equiv. They then call different helpers with different hypotheses, hG.false_of_four_le_localRank and hG.false_of_three_le_localRank. The shared part is three routine lines of unfolding and instance setup. A new helper lemma would save little and would not clear the rubric's bar for nontrivial repeated mathematics. The six family theorems are thin wrappers around these two lemmas. They differ only in the group type and the index, so they are wrappers around existing API, not repeated proof machinery. le_localRank_of_hasWitness is a single-use unpacking of HasWitness into an existing lemma. I found no justified finding. I did not open the definitions of Excluded433 or HasWitness in detail, since the duplicated blocks are routine either way.
